map.IPv4 = 32 位无符号整数；点分十进制按 8 位一段切成 4 段（每段 0: IPv4 = a 32-bit unsigned integer; dotted decimal splits the 32 bits into four 8-bit segments (each 0 to 255)
map.IPv4 地址本质是一个 32 位整数，范围 0 ~ 4,294,967,295: An IPv4 address is essentially a 32-bit integer from 0 to 4,294,967,295, corresponding to 0.0.0.0 through 255.255.255.255. Dotted decimal writes those 32 bits as four decimal numbers, one per 8-bit segment; the binary string writes the same 32 bits as 0s and 1s with a dot every 8 bits, making network and host bits easy to see; the decimal integer form makes it easy to store, sort and deduplicate in a BIGINT column. This tool converts losslessly among the three forms: enter any one and pick the target format. The conversion uses pure bitwise arithmetic, so it is exact and reversible as long as the input is valid (four segments of 0 to 255, a 32-bit 0/1 string, or an integer from 0 to 4,294,967,295).
